prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT IMAGE1 ONLY, an already finished game sprite action atlas. IMAGE2 is ONLY a small stone material texture swatch, not geometry or pose reference. Make a strictly local surface finish change within the existing petricite panels: add restrained pale beige/warmgray mineral mottling and granular texture comparable to the swatch, soften the dark comic seam lines with warmbrown actual occlusion and reflected coolgray shadow light. Keep all gold trim, blue cloth, exact winged Demacian crest, amber insets and every plate's geometry, outline and lighting direction. It should read as richly textured late1990s prerendered HeroesIII stone, not flat toon blocks or glossy toy. DO NOT change or redraw the poses.
Critical invariant: preserve EXACT image1 canvas and grid, EVERY limb, fist, foot, head silhouette, individual pose's pixel size and POSITION, camera, margins and transparency. The 6 action poses must remain distinct at their EXACT original anchors. Especially preserve lower-row figure positions and feet. DO NOT auto-center, enlarge, shrink, respace, change perspective, recompose, add/remove armor or move any limb. Only paint existing surface material. Keep all gutters genuinely transparent, no checkerboard, ground plane, labels or added shadow.
